$doc: A row of buttons or button-shaped links, and the whole component is four declarations because that is all a row of buttons needs — once it is a flex container rather than a paragraph of inline-blocks. The two gaps are NAMED SEPARATELY rather than written as one `gap`, and the reason is the defect this replaced: the work pages spaced their buttons with an inline `margin-right` on every anchor but the last, so the column gap was right and the ROW gap was whatever the line box gave it, which measured at 1px. A shorthand would have made those two numbers one decision; they are one value today and two decisions, and the row gap is the one that was wrong.

block.title: Actions
note: The row a page's calls to action sit in. It carries no appearance of its own —
a `.btn` still looks like a `.btn` — and exists only to say that these buttons
are ONE group that wraps as a group. Anything that needs to look different is a
button variant, not a variant of this.
